Pokémon that appear while this Timed Research is active have the same chance of appearing as Shiny Pokémon as those that can be encountered via Field Research tasks during the event. 

This Timed Research will be available on June 3, 2023, from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time. Learn more in the in-game News.
